draft.text: You came in because you had shortness of breath and lightheadedness after a 3-hour bike ride.
You also had some chest pain that went away after an hour.
We did not find any results from tests or exams during this visit.
Your symptoms may be related to asthma or bronchospasm.
We do not think your migraines or reflux are causing these symptoms.
You will have a pulmonary function test or spirometry to check for asthma or bronchospasm.
You will also see a doctor for more evaluation and care.
